worker_claim.report: The current forced-retry path requires a live persisted execution binding, and prepare_rework retires the workspace of its reported predecessor. A safe historical continuation therefore needs a distinct durable authorization and staged transaction that binds the operator's explicit ownership assumption to both generations before any ref or worktree mutation; adapting forced retry or substituting the failed checkpoint into rework would bypass those invariants. That transaction has not been implemented or verified in this invocation. Focused review-provenance tests pass; ruff is unavailable in the environment. Exact-checkpoint CI requires a checkpoint created by Devlegate.
worker_claim.summary: Hardened the review resolver to reject transport-failed or invalid-egress executions even when called independently of report selection. Added focused regression coverage for both failure modes.
